workContent:
Join Deloitte China

Deloitte China provides integrated professional services to our clients with a one-stop shop offering of world-leading audit, tax, and consulting services.

• We are the world's largest professional services firm that changes the world, leading with purpose and shared values.
• We are market leader in digital and innovative solutions, creating value for client through our multi-disciplinary services.
• We are certified as one of the ‘Best Workplaces™ in Greater China and recognized as a Top Employer in China by the Top Employers Institute* since 2006！

Consulting provides enduring value to the world's most important organizations. With 7000+ consulting and delivery practitioners, Deloitte consulting delivers innovative solutions through Strategy, Risk & Transactions and Technology & Transformation. Across disciplines, we connect the optimal mix of Deloitte's industry, functional and technology capabilities with the best of our Alliances to orchestrate the outcomes our clients seek. We aspire to be our clients' Most Valuable Partner, with our people, platforms and AI integral to creating shared value at the heart of their business.

Work You'll Do

By joining Deloitte Cybersecurity Advisory Service, you will:

• Provide Cybersecurity consulting, implementation, operation and maintenance services for clients, including but not limited to: IT infrastructure security, security governance and compliance, data protection and privacy, penetration testing and vulnerability management, cloud security, industrial control security, SAP application security and implementation, business continuity management, cyber security awareness and the operating of Security Operations Center, etc.
• There is an opportunity to provide Cybersecurity Advisory Service and implementation services covering the full digital ecosystem for many local and even Global leading enterprise clients, so as to enhance your professional vision and ability in your cyber career.

加入德勤网络安全咨询团队，您会：

• 为客户提供网络安全咨询，实施及运维服务，涉及安全领域包括但不限于：IT基础架构安全、信息安全治理和合规、数据保护及隐私、渗透测试及漏洞管理，云安全，工控安全，SAP应用安全及实施，业务持续性管理，网络安全态势感知和安全运营中心运维等。
• 有机会为众多全国乃至全球领先的企业客户提供覆盖全数字生态的网络安全咨询及实施服务，提升您在网络安全职业生涯中专业视野和能力。

During your tenure as an analyst in Cybersecurity, you will demonstrate and develop your leadership and professional capabilities in the following areas: Building diverse capability, Collaborating, Creating purpose, Delivering value, Driving agility, Influencing, Inspiring, Building the Business, Analytical Acumen, Effective Communication, Delivery Excellence, Managing Change, Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving and Tech Savviness.
serviceCondition:
• Be honest and trustworthy, responsible, and team awareness. Interested and enthusiastic in the professional service field of Cybersecurity Advisory Service.
• Bachelor degree or above in information security, network security, information system management, computer science, software engineering or related majors.
• Good communication skills, structured thinking ability, analysis and problem solving ability, fast learning ability, professional practice ability, skilled writing ability.

• 为人诚实守信，有责任心，有团队意识，对网络安全咨询的专业服务领域有兴趣、有热情。
• 信息安全、网络安全、信息系统管理、计算机科学、软件工程或相关专业本科及以上学历。
• 具有良好的沟通能力、结构化思维能力、分析与解决问题能力、快速学习能力，专业实践能力，熟练的文字表达能力。

Priorities:
优先考虑方面:

Professional Practices:
• Good oral and written English skills; Or have multiple languages (such as Japanese, French, etc) ability is preferred
• Or, with professional knowledge of information security service or system, relevant laws and regulations of information technology in financial industry, relevant standards in IT management field (such as ISO27001/20000, ITIL, COBIT, etc.), and other relevant experience is preferred
• Or, those with relevant experience China cybersecurity-related laws and regulations (such as Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, etc.) and overseas privacy laws, such as Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, GDPR, etc. are preferred
• Or, above relevant project or internship experience is preferred
• Or, ability or experience related to car networking security and Internet of Things security is preferred

Professional Certifications:
• Holding information security related certification, such as CISSP, CISP, CPCS Evaluator is preferred
• Or holding cloud security-related certifications, such as CCSP, ACP, AWS Certified, etc. are preferred
• Or holding data and privacy related certifications, such as CIPT, CIPM, CIPP, HCISPP, etc. preferred
• Or holding cyber offensive security related certification, such as OSCP, OSWE, GPEN, GXPN, etc. is preferred
• Or holding other professional consulting service Certification, such as CISA, PMP, ITIL, CEH, etc.

专业实践：
• 具备良好的英语口语表达能力和写作能力；或具备多种语言（如日语，法语等）能力优先
• 或，具有信息安全咨询或安全体系制度的专业知识、金融行业信息科技相关法律法规，IT管理领域的相关标准（如ISO27001/20000、ITIL、COBIT等）等相关经验者优先
• 或，具有与中国网络安全相关法律法规（如网络安全法，数据安全法，个人信息保护法等）及海外相关隐私法律，如网络安全法，数据安全法，个人信息保护法，GDPR等相关经验者优先
• 或，具有以上相关的项目或实习经验优先
• 或，具有车联网安全、物联网安全相关能力或经验优先

专业认证:
• 持有信息安全相关认证，例如CISSP，CISP，网络等级保护（CPCS）测评师等优先
• 或持有云安全相关认证，例如CCSP，ACP，AWS Certified等优先
• 或持有数据及隐私相关认证，例如CIPT，CIPM，CIPP，HCISPP等优先
• 或持有网络攻防相关认证，例如OSCP，OSWE,GPEN,GXPN等优先
• 或持有其他专业咨询服务认证，例如CISA，PMP，ITIL，CEH等优先

At Deloitte, we know we’re at our best when we look out for one another; prioritize respect, fairness, development and wellbeing; foster an inclusive culture and embrace diversity in all forms. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background, experience, identity, ability or thinking style, and if you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process for accessibility reasons this is available upon request. The preferred candidate will be subject to background screening by Deloitte or by their external third-party provider.
